targetRegionEvidence.provenance: Objective: Kiev printed rules §6.0(7) (page 2) and §10.8 (page 5); user-approved 2026-11-21 rule interpretation that exactly the four Romanian setup hexes are Romanian targets for this first-turn combat restriction. This is not a complete historical country boundary.

airSupport.source: references/rules/kiev-rules.pdf §10.5; references/rules/kiev-player-aid.webp; original photographed front/reverse counters

notes: The shared B4M CRT applies by project decision, not the alternate printed Kiev CRT.

Italian CSIR is source-captioned Motorized Infantry in §11 but has a photographed infantry NATO glyph; the exact face override permits motorized special movement and infantry-style combat without reclassifying unrelated infantry counters.

§10.8 is executable as a user-adjudicated four-setup-hex Turn-1 target convention. This does NOT establish the whole geographic Romanian boundary or independently authorize the provisional Kiev movement graph.
The existing Kiev movement graph remains diagnostic-only, not promoted to historical play.
Kiev has no naval Fleet marker; Air Corps is committed to ground battles without a preliminary naval-attack window. Other scenarios retain their existing phase behavior.
